intent: Group an alert dialog's media, title and description into one block at the top of the popup.
typical_uses: The block at the top of an AlertDialogContent holding the question and its consequence

dont_use_when.situation: The header of a dismissible modal

invariants.text: The header is sticky at the top of the popup with an opaque background matching it, so content scrolling inside AlertDialogContent passes under it rather than through it.
The header centers its children and their text; only inside a `size="default"` popup from a 640px viewport does it align them to the start and the text to the left.

rtl.by: alert-dialog.module.css sets a physical `text-align: left` on the header inside a wide default popup, so in a right-to-left page the text keeps to the left while `place-items: start` moves the items to the right

good.title: A warning glyph, a title and a description
good.code:
<AlertDialogHeader>
  <AlertDialogMedia>
    <WarningIcon />
  </AlertDialogMedia>
  <AlertDialogTitle>Delete this project?</AlertDialogTitle>
  <AlertDialogDescription>Its files and history are removed for everyone.</AlertDialogDescription>
</AlertDialogHeader>

bad.title: The actions folded into the header
bad.why: The actions belong in AlertDialogFooter, which pins them to the bottom of the popup and lays them out by `size`; inside the header they sit under the text in the header's alignment instead, centered, or at the start from a 640px-wide viewport at the default size.
